title: GLEIF Legal Entities
description: A semantic package over the GLEIF Level 1 and Level 2 golden-copy data held in the semvia-test-data Postgres instance. Ships a small legal-entity ontology, an svdb:PostgresConnection descriptor carrying no credential, and three RML TriplesMaps that expose lei_records and relationship_records as a virtual RDF graph — nothing is copied, every read is answered by the database.
